title: Protocol and Extraction
author: Tamsin Brightwater
blurb: Emrys Amberdale, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
